name: 介護補償の限度額と葬祭補償額を引き上げ
summary: 現在、介護補償の限度額は85,490円と42,700円、葬祭補償額は315,000円です。議案ではこれらをそれぞれ90,790円、45,400円、330,000円に改め、令和8年4月1日以後に支給の対象となる事由が生じた補償に適用します。
changes: 介護補償の限度額を85,490円から90,790円に改める
介護補償のもう1区分の限度額を42,700円から45,400円に改める
葬祭補償額を315,000円から330,000円に改める
who: 台東区立小中学校等の学校医
台東区立小中学校等の学校歯科医
台東区立小中学校等の学校薬剤師
why: 介護補償の限度額と葬祭補償の額を改定するためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Raises the maximum care compensation and funeral compensation amounts
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Compensation for Work-Related Accidents of School Physicians, School Dentists, and School Pharmacists at Taito City Municipal Elementary and Junior High Schools, etc.
en.summary: The current maximum care compensation amounts are ¥85,490 and ¥42,700, and the funeral compensation amount is ¥315,000. The bill changes these to ¥90,790, ¥45,400, and ¥330,000, respectively, and applies to compensation for which the event giving rise to eligibility for payment occurs on or after April 1, 2026.
changes: Raises one maximum care compensation amount from ¥85,490 to ¥90,790
Raises the other maximum care compensation amount from ¥42,700 to ¥45,400
Raises the funeral compensation amount from ¥315,000 to ¥330,000
who: School physicians at Taito City municipal elementary and junior high schools, etc.
School dentists at Taito City municipal elementary and junior high schools, etc.
School pharmacists at Taito City municipal elementary and junior high schools, etc.
en.why: The mayor says the purpose is to revise the maximum care compensation amounts and the funeral compensation amount.
